# Debrief: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus

These clips show how OpenTelemetry and Prometheus fit together: ingesting OTLP and scraping with the Collector, Prometheus 3 changes such as native histograms, and practical migration lessons from a production rebuild. ([Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 3:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=192s); [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 15:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=913s); [Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 30:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=1836s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. The Collector's Prometheus receiver scrapes metrics endpoints, transforms data and updates resource attributes, then exports via OTLP. This is a direct bridge between existing Prometheus targets and an OpenTelemetry pipeline. ([We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 15:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=913s))
2. Prometheus native histograms are stable. Since 3.9 you must configure ingestion at scrape level, and Prometheus has added features to its OTLP receive endpoint. Kubernetes metrics still need native histogram support. ([Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 3:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=192s))
3. After moving to OTLP, the team's Grafana dashboard queries needed only small changes, such as underscores to periods. Collector internal metrics can alert when too much data is being sent. ([We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 26:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=1563s))

## Action items

- [ ] Prototype a Collector pipeline that uses the Prometheus receiver to scrape an existing target, adjusts resource attributes in a processor, and exports over OTLP. ([We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 15:13](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=913s); [We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 12:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=720s))
- [ ] Check your Prometheus version and try enabling native histograms on one scrape job, noting the scrape-level configuration required from 3.9 onward. ([Prometheus V3 One Year In: OpenMetrics 2.0 and More! · 3:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6vE9b6StC0g&t=192s))
- [ ] Audit existing dashboard queries and alerts for underscore versus dot metric naming differences before switching to OTLP-sourced metrics. ([We Deleted Our Observability Stack and Rebuilt It With OTEL: 12 Engineers to 4 at 20K+ Clusters · 26:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0oum6Eh1is&t=1563s); [OpenTelemetry Collector SIG: Project Updates · 18:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0zwLl8QGOdM&t=1128s))
